description:
Produce a short benchmark-gap strategy note that records how the new algorithmic tasks integrate with the existing PPC Tier A-D plan and prevents duplicated or contradictory work.

## Background

The epic now contains both low-level PPC kernel tasks and higher-level algorithmic benchmark-gap tasks. Without an integration note, workers may optimize the same path twice or make incompatible crossover assumptions.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] A document under `dev/active/` maps each `64c88ae4` gap to the responsible JIT task(s), dependencies, benchmark evidence, and non-goals.
- [hard] The document defines how Strassen/Winograd, delayed reduction, GF(2^m) matrix tiling, and existing Tier A-D kernels compose without conflicting public APIs.
- [hard] The document explicitly records which decisions are measured locally vs. require user escalation.
- [hard] The document is linked to this story and the three implementation tasks via `jit doc add`.
- [hard] `code-review` and `doc-review` gates pass.
title: Map 64c88ae4 benchmark gaps into PPC execution plan
